reply.subject: Re: Your Growth Blueprint and page content are ready
reply.body:
Hi Maya,

I hope the deck found you well. I asked for your thoughts on the Blueprint by Friday, December 4, and I know the week gets busy.

So the build keeps moving, we will go ahead with the Blueprint as it stands and start on the next stage of the site. Your feedback is still welcome at any point, and anything you send will be reviewed before we change the plan.

If a short call to walk through the deck would help, just say so and I'll set one up.

Thanks,
